findings.title: Normal Store cleanup deletes the retained stage stderr before failure recording

evidence.observation: run_stage redirects child stderr to T/.provision-stderr/<stage>.stderr, creates the file mode 0600, preserves the child return code, and writes only bounded public diagnostics.
Store.ensure catches the build failure, calls _roll(journal, False) first, and only then calls _record_failure(failure_name, evidence).
_roll deletes the new staging entry through _delete_owned; the recursive deletion removes .provision-stderr before the bounded failure record is written.
The production dispatcher invokes make-child-venv in the background and publishes only its bounded command output; it does not preserve the deleted staging tree.

findings.impact: The required exact first stderr is available only during the maker's isolated run or diagnostic-retention path, not after an ordinary failed dispatcher -> maker -> Store request. Timeout and non-timeout stage failures therefore remain EXACTMISSING at the required handoff.
findings.minimum_fix: At the existing Store failure/cleanup boundary, atomically preserve the maker-owned stage stderr (or a private bounded copy with its stage and digest) before _roll deletes staging, enforce regular-file ownership, 0600 mode, size and safe stage-name checks, and keep it out of the public failure marker. This requires a reviewed Store/STORE_PY interface change or an equivalent pre-cleanup handoff; do not add a second investigator, expose raw stderr publicly, or weaken the unchanged verifier.

non_findings: Current STORE_PY and STORE_VERIFY embedded blocks are byte-exact against the parent candidate.
Protected bench_store.py and verify_dependency_seed.py hashes match the recorded kit values.
The private CAS installer accepted only the exact WITHDRAWN/NOTRUN D137 decision and passed target preimage CAS, no-clobber backup, identity lock, atomic replacement, and helper readback.
No generic environment bypass, synthetic E2E PASS, live install, Store initialization, child request, acquisition, or production target write was performed.
